'''Plaeree''' was an ancient [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. The [[Point of Parting/Legends|Point of Parting]] that stood at the gates of the city's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was claimed to be the original plaza that inspired other cities to establish a point of parting at every starport on the planet. The structure was still in use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="NoP" />
